debianVersion.upstream: nonempty portion after epoch and before final Debian revision separator
debianVersion.revision: portion after final hyphen, default empty
debianVersion.equality: exact normalized tuple; no semantic ordering or coercion

sourcePackages: Source metadata is retained on a Debian binary package when present. Standalone source-package SPDX entries are unsupported and quarantine.
node: One pkg:generic/node purl must exactly match the independently derived Node semver and OCI config architecture.
duplicates: Duplicate identity or SPDXID always quarantines, including byte-identical duplicates.
relationships: Exactly one SPDXRef-DOCUMENT DESCRIBES relationship per admitted package and no other relationship is accepted.
permittedRepresentationalDifferences: percent-encoding in purl name and version components
equality: Exact set equality after strict parsing and frozen normalization; every derived entry and every attached entry must map one-to-one.
policyOverride: No caller-selected comparison policy, ignored field, identity list, or relaxation is accepted.
